intro.zh: slugify 把一句话变成网址里能用的别名。它认识 🦄 和 ♥，但遇到 🚀 和 🔥 会直接丢掉。
intro.en: slugify turns a sentence into a URL slug. It knows 🦄 and ♥, but silently drops 🚀 and 🔥.

zh: 🚀 变成 rocket，🔥 变成 fire，和已有的 🦄 一样作为独立单词。
用户通过 customReplacements 传入同一个 emoji 时，用户的写法优先。
en: 🚀 becomes rocket and 🔥 becomes fire, each a word of its own, the way 🦄 already works.
When the caller passes the same emoji in customReplacements, the caller's version wins.

hint.zh: 只用改 overridable-replacements.js：照着 🦄 那一行，加上 ['🚀', ' rocket '] 和 ['🔥', ' fire ']。
hint.en: Only overridable-replacements.js needs a change: next to the 🦄 line, add ['🚀', ' rocket '] and ['🔥', ' fire '].
